## Table of Contents

### Classes

* [`pe_snapshot`](#pe_snapshot): Maps this node to the hypervisor endpoint that can snapshot it.
* [`pe_snapshot::proxy`](#pe_snapshot--proxy): Configures a node to talk to hypervisor APIs for pe_snapshot, and sweeps expired snapshots.

### Functions

* [`pe_snapshot::creds_json`](#pe_snapshot--creds_json): Turns endpoint credentials into the JSON written to the proxy's credentials file.
* [`pe_snapshot::tag`](#pe_snapshot--tag): The tag a plan acts on: the one given, else a pe_patch runbook's run_id.

### Tasks

* [`create`](#create): Snapshot each VM through an endpoint on this proxy. Run on the proxy, usually by the pe_snapshot::create plan.
* [`delete`](#delete): Delete managed snapshots by tag or name. Deleting one already gone succeeds. Run on the proxy.
* [`list`](#list): List the managed snapshots on each VM. Read only. Run on the proxy.
* [`marker`](#marker): Add or remove a snapshot in the target node's marker file, read by the pe_snapshot fact. Run on the target by the plans.
* [`restore`](#restore): Roll one VM back to a managed snapshot. Run on the proxy, through the pe_snapshot::restore plan.

### Plans

#### Public Plans

* [`pe_snapshot::create`](#pe_snapshot--create): Snapshots each target through the proxy that serves it, with an expiry.
* [`pe_snapshot::delete`](#pe_snapshot--delete): Deletes managed snapshots by tag or name on each target.
* [`pe_snapshot::list`](#pe_snapshot--list): Lists the managed snapshots on each target, asking the hypervisor, not the facts.
* [`pe_snapshot::restore`](#pe_snapshot--restore): Rolls one node back to a managed snapshot.

#### Private Plans

* `pe_snapshot::dispatch`: Runs a pe_snapshot task on each proxy for its share of the targets and returns one value per target.
* `pe_snapshot::resolve`: Groups targets by the proxy and endpoint that can snapshot them, from the pe_snapshot fact in PuppetDB.

## Classes

### <a name="pe_snapshot"></a>`pe_snapshot`

Declare on every node that can be snapshotted. Each value comes from Hiera
first and is detected from facts second, so it can be set per node, location
or network zone. The result is written where the pe_snapshot fact reads it,
and the plans find the proxy for a node through that fact.

#### Examples

##### Hiera for a site whose VMs are on one Proxmox cluster

```puppet
pe_snapshot::proxy: puppet.lab.example.com
pe_snapshot::endpoint: lab_pve
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `pe_snapshot` class:

* [`provider`](#-pe_snapshot--provider)
* [`proxy`](#-pe_snapshot--proxy)
* [`endpoint`](#-pe_snapshot--endpoint)
* [`vm_id`](#-pe_snapshot--vm_id)
* [`virtual_map`](#-pe_snapshot--virtual_map)

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--provider"></a>`provider`

Data type: `Optional[Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/]]`

Provider name. Detected from cloud metadata facts, then from the virtual
fact through virtual_map.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--proxy"></a>`proxy`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Certname of the node that talks to the hypervisor API for this node. It
needs pe_snapshot::proxy with a matching endpoint.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--endpoint"></a>`endpoint`

Data type: `Optional[Variant[Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/], Array[Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/], 1]]]`

Name of the endpoint on the proxy, or a list of them. Use a list where the
VM can move between hosts or clusters that have separate APIs (standalone
ESXi, libvirt hosts, more than one vCenter). The VM is looked up on each
and must be found on exactly one. Don't list the same cluster twice.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--vm_id"></a>`vm_id`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The provider's identity for this VM. Detected per provider: the SMBIOS
uuid for proxmox, vsphere and libvirt, zone/name for gce, the instance id
for aws, the resource id for azure.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--virtual_map"></a>`virtual_map`

Data type: `Hash[String[1], Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/]]`

Maps values of the virtual fact to a provider. kvm can't tell Proxmox from
plain libvirt, so set provider in Hiera where the default is wrong.

Default value: `{}`

### <a name="pe_snapshot--proxy"></a>`pe_snapshot::proxy`

The plans run their tasks on this node. Each endpoint gets a config file and
a root-only credentials file under /etc/puppetlabs/pe_snapshot/endpoints.
The pe_snapshot_proxy fact lists every managed snapshot on those endpoints,
and when it shows expired ones this class deletes exactly those. A run only
reports a change when something was deleted.

Linux only.

#### Examples

##### Hiera for one Proxmox cluster

```puppet
pe_snapshot::proxy::endpoints:
  - name: lab_pve
    provider: proxmox
    url: https://pve1.example.com:8006
pe_snapshot::proxy::credentials:
  lab_pve: ENC[PKCS7,...]
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `pe_snapshot::proxy` class:

* [`endpoints`](#-pe_snapshot--proxy--endpoints)
* [`credentials`](#-pe_snapshot--proxy--credentials)
* [`default_retention_hours`](#-pe_snapshot--proxy--default_retention_hours)
* [`max_retention_hours`](#-pe_snapshot--proxy--max_retention_hours)
* [`allow_no_expiry`](#-pe_snapshot--proxy--allow_no_expiry)
* [`sweep`](#-pe_snapshot--proxy--sweep)

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--proxy--endpoints"></a>`endpoints`

Data type:

```puppet
Array[Struct[{
    name                 => Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/],
    provider             => Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/],
    Optional[url]        => String[1],
    Optional[verify_tls] => Boolean,
    Optional[ca_file]    => Stdlib::Absolutepath,
    Optional[options]    => Hash[String[1], Data],
  }]]
```

The hypervisor or cloud endpoints this proxy can reach. Provider-specific
settings go in options and are merged into the endpoint's config.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--proxy--credentials"></a>`credentials`

Data type: `Variant[Sensitive[Hash], Hash]`

Credentials per endpoint name. Each value is a Hash, a JSON string, or a
Deferred that returns one of those (a Vault or KMS lookup), which resolves
on this node at run time and so never enters the catalog. Converted to
Sensitive by the module's lookup_options.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--proxy--default_retention_hours"></a>`default_retention_hours`

Data type: `Integer[1]`

Expiry for a snapshot created without retention_hours.

Default value: `24`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--proxy--max_retention_hours"></a>`max_retention_hours`

Data type: `Integer[1]`

The longest retention a caller may ask for. Longer requests are refused.

Default value: `168`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--proxy--allow_no_expiry"></a>`allow_no_expiry`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether retention_hours 0, meaning no expiry, is accepted.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--proxy--sweep"></a>`sweep`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether agent runs delete expired snapshots.

Default value: `true`

## Functions

### <a name="pe_snapshot--creds_json"></a>`pe_snapshot::creds_json`

Type: Ruby 4.x API

Runs at compile time for plain or Sensitive values, and on the proxy agent
when the credentials are Deferred, so a KMS lookup never puts the secret in
the catalog. Accepts a Hash, a JSON string, or either wrapped in Sensitive,
with Sensitive values nested at any depth.

#### `pe_snapshot::creds_json(Variant[Sensitive, Hash, String] $creds)`

Runs at compile time for plain or Sensitive values, and on the proxy agent
when the credentials are Deferred, so a KMS lookup never puts the secret in
the catalog. Accepts a Hash, a JSON string, or either wrapped in Sensitive,
with Sensitive values nested at any depth.

Returns: `Sensitive[String]` The credentials as a JSON object.

##### `creds`

Data type: `Variant[Sensitive, Hash, String]`

The credentials.

## Tasks

### <a name="create"></a>`create`

Snapshot each VM through an endpoint on this proxy. Run on the proxy, usually by the pe_snapshot::create plan.

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `provider`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Provider name. Checked against the endpoint, which is authoritative.

##### `endpoint`

Data type: `Variant[Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/], Array[Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/], 1]]`

Endpoint name, or a list of them, configured on this proxy by pe_snapshot::proxy. With a list, each VM is looked up on every endpoint and must be found on exactly one.

##### `vms`

Data type: `Array[Struct[{certname => String[1], vm_id => String[1]}], 1]`

The VMs to act on, as certname and the vm_id from the pe_snapshot fact.

##### `credentials`

Data type: `Optional[Hash]`

Credentials to merge with the proxy credentials file. A key in both is an error.

##### `concurrency`

Data type: `Optional[Integer[1, 50]]`

How many VMs to work on at once.

##### `tag`

Data type: `String[1]`

Groups the snapshots from one run. Delete and restore select by it.

##### `retention_hours`

Data type: `Optional[Integer[0]]`

Hours until the sweep deletes the snapshot. Defaults to the proxy setting, refused above the proxy maximum. 0 means no expiry where the proxy allows it.

##### `memory`

Data type: `Optional[Boolean]`

Include RAM state where the provider supports it.

##### `quiesce`

Data type: `Optional[Boolean]`

Ask the provider to quiesce the guest filesystem where it supports that.

##### `by`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Recorded in the snapshot metadata as the creator.

## Plans

### <a name="pe_snapshot--create"></a>`pe_snapshot::create`

Works on its own and as a pe_patch::runbook step (type: plan, context: true),
where the runbook's run_id becomes the tag. Returns one Result per target. A
node whose snapshot failed has an _error value, so a runbook step can drop it.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `pe_snapshot::create` plan:

* [`targets`](#-pe_snapshot--create--targets)
* [`tag`](#-pe_snapshot--create--tag)
* [`pe_patch_context`](#-pe_snapshot--create--pe_patch_context)
* [`retention_hours`](#-pe_snapshot--create--retention_hours)
* [`memory`](#-pe_snapshot--create--memory)
* [`quiesce`](#-pe_snapshot--create--quiesce)
* [`credentials`](#-pe_snapshot--create--credentials)
* [`marker`](#-pe_snapshot--create--marker)

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--create--targets"></a>`targets`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

The nodes to snapshot.

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--create--tag"></a>`tag`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Groups this run's snapshots for delete and restore. Defaults to pe_patch_context's run_id.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--create--pe_patch_context"></a>`pe_patch_context`

Data type: `Optional[Hash]`

Passed by a pe_patch::runbook step.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--create--retention_hours"></a>`retention_hours`

Data type: `Optional[Integer[0]]`

Hours until the proxy's sweep deletes the snapshot. Defaults to the proxy's setting.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--create--memory"></a>`memory`

Data type: `Boolean`

Include RAM state where the provider supports it.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--create--quiesce"></a>`quiesce`

Data type: `Boolean`

Quiesce the guest filesystem where the provider supports it.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--create--credentials"></a>`credentials`

Data type: `Optional[Sensitive[Hash]]`

Added to the proxy's credentials file. Not usable from a runbook, which is plain data.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--create--marker"></a>`marker`

Data type: `Boolean`

Record the snapshot on each target, for the target's pe_snapshot fact.

Default value: `true`

### <a name="pe_snapshot--restore"></a>`pe_snapshot::restore`

Deliberately narrow: exactly one target, and the tag is required. Not meant
as a runbook step. The snapshot is kept after the rollback, and the node's
marker file is rolled back with the disk, so its pe_snapshot fact won't list
the snapshot until the next create. The proxy's fact still does.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `pe_snapshot::restore` plan:

* [`targets`](#-pe_snapshot--restore--targets)
* [`tag`](#-pe_snapshot--restore--tag)
* [`snapshot_name`](#-pe_snapshot--restore--snapshot_name)
* [`start`](#-pe_snapshot--restore--start)
* [`credentials`](#-pe_snapshot--restore--credentials)

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--restore--targets"></a>`targets`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

The one node to restore.

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--restore--tag"></a>`tag`

Data type: `String[1]`

Tag of the snapshot to restore.

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--restore--snapshot_name"></a>`snapshot_name`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Needed when more than one snapshot has the tag.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--restore--start"></a>`start`

Data type: `Boolean`

Start the VM after the rollback.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-pe_snapshot--restore--credentials"></a>`credentials`

Data type: `Optional[Sensitive[Hash]]`

Added to the proxy's credentials file.

Default value: `undef`
